item: {"addr": "0x1402f08d0", "comment": "A reference's display name, the one every UI reads (crosshair, activate text, subtitles, enemy health, barter): ExtraTextDisplayData on the reference if any, else the base's TESFullName (14720). Read 2026-11-05."}

{"addr": "0x1403b0550", "comment": "Writes TESFullName only with change flag 0x20 (TESNPC kFullName). A player base never named this session has no 0x20, so a form built from those bytes stays unnamed."}
{"addr": "0x1409718d0", "comment": "The race menu's name: writes the player base's TESFullName (0xE0) and marks change flag 0x20. Only this marks it."}

{"addr": "0x140162f60", "comment": "A quest alias's display name on a reference: ExtraTextDisplayData with message (+0x18), quest (+0x20), alias (+0x28); pooled name cleared. Called through TESObjectREFR::SetQuestDisplayName."}
{"addr": "0x140163110", "comment": "Removes the reference's ExtraTextDisplayData if it is this message's and quest's: back to the base's name. From BGSRefAlias::ClearRefAlias (24012)."}
{"addr": "0x140189950", "comment": "ExtraTextDisplayData from a save: message, quest, alias id; a custom name (alias -2) follows as text."}

{"addr": "0x14039fde0", "comment": "The alias's data onto the reference, its display name too: only with the alias's display name message or flag 0x4000, and only if the reference has no other ExtraTextDisplayData (+0x20 is this quest and the alias differs)."}
